title: pinout-asyncapi contract-tests config (input DTO)
description: Input DTO for the one-shot CLI `pinout-asyncapi validate <config.yaml>`. Assembled by the cli ingress door into ONE flat Invocation handed to the head. Symmetric with the sync twin pinout-openapi/api-specification/config.schema.json — async-specific: `channels` (channel addresses) instead of `operations` (path+method). Provider spec via `spec_path` XOR `spec_url`. FROZEN: this is the sole input contract of the service.

consumer.description: The consumer under test and the channel scope to check (only these channels are compared).

consumed_contract_path.description: Path to the consumer's `consumed-contract` artifact (schema-shaped, typed, + provenance; see consumed-contract.schema.json). Missing/unreadable at runtime -> FILE_NOT_FOUND (exit 3); unparseable or schema-invalid -> PARSE_ERROR (exit 3).

channels.description: Comparison scope: the channel ADDRESSES the consumer depends on. Identity of a channel is its AsyncAPI `channel.address`; when a spec omits `address`, the channel key is used as the address (concept.md D4). Every listed address MUST be present in the consumed-contract, otherwise CONFIG_ERROR (exit 2). Provider channels outside this set are informational (report.uncovered_channels[]).

items.description: Channel address, e.g. `RECEIPT.QUEUE.PS` or `/api/client/{clientId}/wallet/balance`. Empty string -> CONFIG_ERROR (exit 2).

provider.description: The provider master AsyncAPI 3.0 spec, reachable via EXACTLY ONE of `spec_path` (local file) or `spec_url` (HTTP GET). Both-set or neither-set -> CONFIG_ERROR (exit 2).

spec_path.description: Path to a local AsyncAPI 3.0 file (.yaml/.yml/.json). Mutually exclusive with `spec_url`. Relative paths resolve against the config file's directory. Missing -> FILE_NOT_FOUND (exit 3); unparseable -> PARSE_ERROR (exit 3).

spec_url.description: http(s) URL to the raw AsyncAPI 3.0 spec (HTTP GET). Mutually exclusive with `spec_path`. Private URLs authenticated via header `Authorization: Bearer $PINOUT_PROVIDER_TOKEN` sourced from env only (never config/git). Unreachable/non-2xx -> HTTP_ERROR (exit 3); fetch > `settings.timeout` -> TIMEOUT_ERROR (exit 3); unparseable body -> PARSE_ERROR (exit 3).

settings.description: Optional run settings; all defaulted, all symmetric with the sync twin. Any invalid value -> CONFIG_ERROR (exit 2).

log_level.description: Diagnostics level on stderr. Value outside the enum -> CONFIG_ERROR (exit 2).

save_json_report.description: When true, write the schema-valid JSON report (report.schema.json) to `json_report_file` for pinout-netlist aggregation. The report is printed to stdout regardless.

json_report_file.description: Report file name. Relative paths resolve against the process working directory.

timeout.description: Max seconds to fetch a provider `spec_url`; exceed -> TIMEOUT_ERROR (exit 3). Value <= 0 -> CONFIG_ERROR (exit 2).

ignore_warnings.description: Reserved (twin symmetry): consider only breaking changes. No behaviour in MVP — every rule R1-R9 is breaking.
